grammar.purpose: Name the agent responsible for an action
grammar.explanation: 活动由学生举办 names the responsible agent before the action. Compare 场地由学校管理 with a person merely attending. A delegation or representative need not be the organizer. In these agentive examples 由 does not mean because; 由于 is a separate causal expression.

examples.py: huó dòng yóu xué sheng jǔ bàn .
chǎng dì yóu xué xiào guǎn lǐ .
huì yì yóu yī wèi xué sheng zhǔ chí .

commonMistakes.wrong: 代表来了，所以活动由他举办。
commonMistakes.right: 代表来交流，举办方要另查。
commonMistakes.why: Attendance or representation does not establish responsibility.

grammar.purpose: Identify the basis for a procedure
grammar.explanation: 按名单分组 gives the grouping basis, while 按照通知上的流程签到 gives a procedural basis. 按到达时间 and 按名单 may yield different groups; read which is stated. The verb 按 in 按按钮 is press, not the preposition according to.

examples.zh: 按照通知上的流程签到。
examples.py: àn zhào tōng zhī shàng de liú chéng qiān dào .
examples.en: Sign in according to the procedure in the notice.

examples.zh: 按组发言，不按到达时间。
examples.py: àn zǔ fā yán , bù àn dào dá shí jiān .
examples.en: Speak by group, not by arrival time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 按名单分组，就是谁先到谁先说。
commonMistakes.right: 按名单分组，顺序要看名单。
commonMistakes.why: Do not replace the stated criterion with arrival order.

dialogue.title: A host, a head and a representative
dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 明天的交流活动，是你们学生会举办的？
lines.py: míng tiān de jiāo liú huó dòng , shì nǐ men xué sheng huì jǔ bàn de ?
lines.en: Is tomorrow's exchange organised by your student union?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，由文艺部负责，我帮忙报到。
lines.py: duì , yóu wén yì bù fù zé , wǒ bāng máng bào dào .
lines.en: Yes. The arts department is handling it. I'm helping with registration.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 谁主持？文艺部部长吗？
lines.py: shéi zhǔ chí ? wén yì bù bù zhǎng ma ?
lines.en: Who's hosting? The head of the arts department?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，小周主持。主任今天来确认过房间。
lines.py: bù shì , xiǎo zhōu zhǔ chí . zhǔ rèn jīn tiān lái què rèn guò fáng jiān .
lines.en: No, Xiao Zhou. The director confirmed the room today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我们几个几点到？
lines.py: wǒ men jǐ gè jǐ diǎn dào ?
lines.en: When should our group arrive?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 九点在门口集中，先签名，再拿名字卡。
lines.py: jiǔ diǎn zài mén kǒu jí zhōng , xiān qiān míng , zài ná míng zi kǎ .
lines.en: Gather at the entrance at nine, sign in, then collect name cards.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不用每个人都发言吧？
lines.py: bù yòng měi gè rén dōu fā yán ba ?
lines.en: Not everyone has to speak, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用，每组派一位代表，按照名单顺序说。
lines.py: bù yòng , měi zǔ pài yī wèi dài biǎo , àn zhào míng dān shùn xù shuō .
lines.en: No. One representative per group, speaking in the order on the list.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 一人说多久？
lines.py: yī rén shuō duō jiǔ ?
lines.en: How long per person?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 两分钟。你说吧，上次旅行的照片也可以放。
lines.py: liǎng fēn zhōng . nǐ shuō ba , shàng cì lǚ xíng de zhào piān yě kě yǐ fàng .
lines.en: Two minutes. Why don't you speak? You can show your travel photos too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我今晚选三张，别一讲就停不下来。
lines.py: nà wǒ jīn wǎn xuǎn sān zhāng , bié yī jiǎng jiù tíng bù xià lái .
lines.en: I'll choose three tonight so I don't talk endlessly.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 放心，小周会提醒你。
lines.py: fàng xīn , xiǎo zhōu huì tí xǐng nǐ .
lines.en: Don't worry. Xiao Zhou will remind you.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Registration and a short talk at a school exchange

reading.title: Read the role, not just the title
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 学校明天举办一次交流活动，由学生会文艺部负责。陈宇帮忙报到，小周主持。我和三个同学一起去，大家让我代表小组发言。
lines.py: xué xiào míng tiān jǔ bàn yī cì jiāo liú huó dòng , yóu xué sheng huì wén yì bù fù zé . chén yǔ bāng máng bào dào , xiǎo zhōu zhǔ chí . wǒ hé sān gè tóng xué yì qǐ qù , dà jiā ràng wǒ dài biǎo xiǎo zǔ fā yán .
lines.en: The school has an exchange tomorrow, organised by the student union's arts department. Chen Yu is helping with registration and Xiao Zhou is hosting. Three classmates and I are going, and they've asked me to speak for our group.

lines.zh: 我晚上选了三张旅行照片，每张准备说几句话。一张是车站，一张是山上的风景，还有一张是我们在雨里找路。
lines.py: wǒ wǎn shang xuǎn le sān zhāng lǚ xíng zhào piān , měi zhāng zhǔn bèi shuō jǐ jù huà . yī zhāng shì chē zhàn , yī zhāng shì shān shàng de fēng jǐng , hái yǒu yī zhāng shì wǒ men zài yǔ lǐ zhǎo lù .
lines.en: That evening I chose three travel photos and prepared a few sentences for each: a station, a mountain view, and us finding our way in the rain.

lines.zh: 第二天九点，我们在门口集中。陈宇让大家按名单签名，再拿自己的名字卡。他看见我的照片，说那张雨里的应该放在最后。
lines.py: dì èr tiān jiǔ diǎn , wǒ men zài mén kǒu jí zhōng . chén yǔ ràng dà jiā àn míng dān qiān míng , zài ná zì jǐ de míng zi kǎ . tā kàn jiàn wǒ de zhào piān , shuō nà zhāng yǔ lǐ de yīng gāi fàng zài zuì hòu .
lines.en: At nine the next day we gathered at the entrance. Chen Yu asked us to sign in following the list and collect our name cards. Seeing my photos, he suggested putting the rainy one last.

lines.zh: 进房间以后，小周先介绍今天的安排。每组代表发言两分钟，其他人可以提问，之后大家再自由聊天。
lines.py: jìn fáng jiān yǐ hòu , xiǎo zhōu xiān jiè shào jīn tiān de ān pái . měi zǔ dài biǎo fā yán liǎng fēn zhōng , qí tā rén kě yǐ tí wèn , zhī hòu dà jiā zài zì yóu liáo tiān .
lines.en: Inside, Xiao Zhou introduced the plan: a two-minute talk from each group's representative, questions from others, then time for everyone to chat freely.

lines.zh: 轮到我时，我先讲车站和山，最后放出雨里的照片。有人问是不是迷路了，我说是，最后是一位路过的奶奶带我们找到车站。
lines.py: lún dào wǒ shí , wǒ xiān jiǎng chē zhàn hé shān , zuì hòu fàng chū yǔ lǐ de zhào piān . yǒu rén wèn shì bú shì mí lù le , wǒ shuō shì , zuì hòu shì yī wèi lù guò de nǎi nai dài wǒ men zhǎo dào chē zhàn .
lines.en: When it was my turn I described the station and mountain, then showed the rainy photo. Someone asked if we'd got lost. We had; a passing grandmother finally led us to the station.

lines.zh: 活动结束，小周来问那张照片还有没有。我发给她，她说下次出门一定带地图。我说地图我们带了，下次要记得打开。
lines.py: huó dòng jié shù , xiǎo zhōu lái wèn nà zhāng zhào piān hái yǒu méi yǒu . wǒ fā gěi tā , tā shuō xià cì chū mén yí dìng dài dì tú . wǒ shuō dì tú wǒ men dài le , xià cì yào jì de dǎ kāi .
lines.en: Afterwards Xiao Zhou asked for that photo. I sent it to her. She said she'd be sure to bring a map next time. We had one, I said; next time we needed to remember to open it.

choices: Travel photos and a story about getting lost

lines.zh: 这次活动由学校举办。
lines.py: zhè cì huó dòng yóu xué xiào jǔ bàn .
lines.en: This event is organised by the school.

lines.zh: 晚饭由我来做。
lines.py: wǎn fàn yóu wǒ lái zuò .
lines.en: I'll take care of dinner.

lines.zh: 请按名单顺序坐。
lines.py: qǐng àn míng dān shùn xù zuò .
lines.en: Please sit in the order on the list.

lines.zh: 门铃坏了，按也没用。
lines.py: mén líng huài le , àn yě méi yòng .
lines.en: The doorbell's broken; pressing it won't help.

lines.zh: 按照地图，我们应该往左走。
lines.py: àn zhào dì tú , wǒ men yīng gāi wǎng zuǒ zǒu .
lines.en: According to the map, we should go left.

lines.zh: 请按照通知上的时间来。
lines.py: qǐng àn zhào tōng zhī shàng de shí jiān lái .
lines.en: Please come at the time on the notice.

lines.zh: 这里每年举办一次书展。
lines.py: zhè lǐ měi nián jǔ bàn yī cì shū zhǎn .
lines.en: A book fair is held here every year.

lines.zh: 学校准备举办一场音乐会。
lines.py: xué xiào zhǔn bèi jǔ bàn yī chǎng yīn yuè huì .
lines.en: The school plans to hold a concert.

lines.zh: 这件事应该问哪个部门？
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì yīng gāi wèn nǎ gè bù mén ?
lines.en: Which department should I ask about this?

lines.zh: 她去年换了一个部门。
lines.py: tā qù nián huàn le yī gè bù mén .
lines.en: She moved to another department last year.

lines.zh: 文艺部部长今天也来了。
lines.py: wén yì bù bù zhǎng jīn tiān yě lái le .
lines.en: The head of the arts department came today too.

lines.zh: 部长让大家先坐下。
lines.py: bù zhǎng ràng dà jiā xiān zuò xià .
lines.en: The department head asked everyone to sit down first.

lines.zh: 办公室主任在开会。
lines.py: bàn gōng shì zhǔ rèn zài kāi huì .
lines.en: The office director is in a meeting.

lines.zh: 我把名单交给主任了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ míng dān jiāo gěi zhǔ rèn le .
lines.en: I handed the list to the director.

lines.zh: 今晚由小周主持。
lines.py: jīn wǎn yóu xiǎo zhōu zhǔ chí .
lines.en: Xiao Zhou will host tonight.

lines.zh: 她第一次主持这么大的活动。
lines.py: tā dì yī cì zhǔ chí zhè me dà de huó dòng .
lines.en: This is her first time hosting an event this large.

lines.zh: 每组请一位代表上来。
lines.py: měi zǔ qǐng yī wèi dài biǎo shàng lái .
lines.en: Could one representative from each group come up?

lines.zh: 这束花代表我们的一点心意。
lines.py: zhè shù huā dài biǎo wǒ men de yī diǎn xīn yì .
lines.en: These flowers are a small token of our appreciation.

lines.zh: 代表团明天到北京。
lines.py: dài biǎo tuán míng tiān dào běi jīng .
lines.en: The delegation arrives in Beijing tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我们在门口等代表团。
lines.py: wǒ men zài mén kǒu děng dài biǎo tuán .
lines.en: We're waiting at the entrance for the delegation.

lines.zh: 老师带领我们参观学校。
lines.py: lǎo shī dài lǐng wǒ men cān guān xué xiào .
lines.en: The teacher led us on a tour of the school.

lines.zh: 他带领大家走进活动室。
lines.py: tā dài lǐng dà jiā zǒu jìn huó dòng shì .
lines.en: He led everyone into the activity room.

lines.zh: 谁负责管理这个房间？
lines.py: shéi fù zé guǎn lǐ zhè gè fáng jiān ?
lines.en: Who's responsible for managing this room?

lines.zh: 她把时间管理得很好。
lines.py: tā bǎ shí jiān guǎn lǐ de hěn hǎo .
lines.en: She manages her time well.

lines.zh: 我们七点在门口集中。
lines.py: wǒ men qī diǎn zài mén kǒu jí zhōng .
lines.en: We'll assemble at the entrance at seven.

lines.zh: 请把桌上的纸集中放在一起。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ zhuō shàng de zhǐ jí zhōng fàng zài yì qǐ .
lines.en: Please gather the papers on the table together.

lines.zh: 会议几点开始？
lines.py: huì yì jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ ?
lines.en: What time does the meeting start?

lines.zh: 今天的会议开了一个小时。
lines.py: jīn tiān de huì yì kāi le yī gè xiǎo shí .
lines.en: Today's meeting lasted an hour.

lines.zh: 这张会员卡是你的吧？
lines.py: zhè zhāng huì yuán kǎ shì nǐ de ba ?
lines.en: This membership card is yours, right?

lines.zh: 会员可以提前订票。
lines.py: huì yuán kě yǐ tí qián dìng piào .
lines.en: Members can book tickets in advance.

lines.zh: 我来办理退票。
lines.py: wǒ lái bàn lǐ tuì piào .
lines.en: I'd like to arrange a ticket refund.

lines.zh: 新卡办好了，手续已经办理完了。
lines.py: xīn kǎ bàn hǎo le , shǒu xù yǐ jīng bàn lǐ wán le .
lines.en: The new card is ready; the formalities are complete.

lines.zh: 办手续需要带什么？
lines.py: bàn shǒu xù xū yào dài shén me ?
lines.en: What do I need to bring to complete the formalities?

lines.zh: 手续不复杂，一会儿就好。
lines.py: shǒu xù bù fù zá , yī huì er jiù hǎo .
lines.en: The procedure is simple; it'll be done shortly.

lines.zh: 新生明天来报到。
lines.py: xīn shēng míng tiān lái bào dào .
lines.en: New students register tomorrow.

lines.zh: 到了以后，先到门口报到。
lines.py: dào le yǐ hòu , xiān dào mén kǒu bào dào .
lines.en: When you arrive, register at the entrance first.

lines.zh: 我第一次在会上发言。
lines.py: wǒ dì yī cì zài huì shàng fā yán .
lines.en: It's my first time speaking at a meeting.

lines.zh: 每个人的发言不超过两分钟。
lines.py: měi gè rén de fā yán bù chāo guò liǎng fēn zhōng .
lines.en: Each person's speech is no longer than two minutes.

lines.zh: 我们派小周去买水。
lines.py: wǒ men pài xiǎo zhōu qù mǎi shuǐ .
lines.en: We'll send Xiao Zhou to buy water.

lines.zh: 公司派她去上海工作。
lines.py: gōng sī pài tā qù shàng hǎi gōng zuò .
lines.en: The company assigned her to work in Shanghai.

lines.zh: 做饭的过程比我想的慢。
lines.py: zuò fàn de guò chéng bǐ wǒ xiǎng de màn .
lines.en: Cooking took longer than I expected.

lines.zh: 在搬家的过程中，我找到了旧照片。
lines.py: zài bān jiā de guò chéng zhōng , wǒ zhǎo dào le jiù zhào piān .
lines.en: I found old photos while moving home.

lines.zh: 他们在网上宣传新开的店。
lines.py: tā men zài wǎng shàng xuān chuán xīn kāi de diàn .
lines.en: They're promoting the new shop online.

lines.zh: 这个宣传视频是学生拍的。
lines.py: zhè gè xuān chuán shì pín shì xué sheng pāi de .
lines.en: Students made this promotional video.

audio.zh: 两分钟。你说吧，上次旅行的照片也可以放。
audio.py: liǎng fēn zhōng . nǐ shuō ba , shàng cì lǚ xíng de zhào piān yě kě yǐ fàng .
audio.en: Two minutes. Why don't you speak? You can show your travel photos too.

tasks.why: This fact is explicitly stated in this clip.

audio.zh: 活动结束，小周来问那张照片还有没有。我发给她，她说下次出门一定带地图。我说地图我们带了，下次要记得打开。
audio.py: huó dòng jié shù , xiǎo zhōu lái wèn nà zhāng zhào piān hái yǒu méi yǒu . wǒ fā gěi tā , tā shuō xià cì chū mén yí dìng dài dì tú . wǒ shuō dì tú wǒ men dài le , xià cì yào jì de dǎ kāi .
audio.en: Afterwards Xiao Zhou asked for that photo. I sent it to her. She said she'd be sure to bring a map next time. We had one, I said; next time we needed to remember to open it.

tasks.statement: The group had brought no map.
tasks.why: This clip explicitly states a different fact.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三20, 三29. Native check: 由 agent construction versus 由于, 按 and 按照 register, 报到 versus 报道, department/head/member roles, 纪念 activity context and grand-title metaphor. No implication of real institution rules. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三14 / 三21 / 三18 / 三69: 她曾经住这里，旧店早已搬走。, 自从毕业，我们很少见面。, 她大概六点到，还没确认。, 要是下雨，就在室内见。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Replaced policy-like lines with rainy-day lunch and muddy-shoe teasing, a wrong-date mix-up, student-union registration and travel photos, and a move with tools, a desk and books. All 88 existing vocabulary IDs get two independent contexts; tasks and grammar ownership preserved. Self-review: class rules out morning, lunch around two, walk after three; old cancellation image and current second-floor seven-o’clock show; four classmates, one representative, two-minute talk, host Xiao Zhou; small box tools, large box books, desk assembled below then carried up, narrator goes down and comes back up. False listening statements contradict their own clip. Native flags: 保险 safer versus insurance, written 仍, empathetic 恐怕, rhetorical 难道, student-union 部长/主任 titles, 代表 token sense, 朝 cháo and 背 bēi, directional 上来/上去/下来/下去 tied to speaker position, and teasing personification of dates/books. Native review pending. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
